items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: Jeff threw the granny dodge in the piss pot.

ctx.x: I'm going to play this. Now, you never had a baby, she named her mother for a gym.

Threw her granny down to the piss pot, to see if he could swim. Now he's a dirty mother for you. Now baby, my side. Now, darling, my side. Now, must I shave and dry? Now, won't you get back, girl? Get your big legs off of mine. Ain't going to be no lagging this time. I'm going to get some of that black behind. I'm a dirty miss, sweetheart. Now, when I'm low-down cheater. Now, when your grandma sure do the lordy lord. Know you want to lay back, dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear…
What's that chord? What's that chord? Okay.
